item.title: 'Everything ends': Highland Park UMC pastor steps down amid Parkinson's fight
item.description: Even in the throes of a bitter winter storm, the Rev. Paul Rasmussen couldn’t help but compare ministry to a day at the beach during his final sermon at Highland Park United Methodist Church in Dallas, Texas. #Texas #UMC #HighlandPark #PaulRasmussen

item.title: Josh Powell to be nominated for Southern Baptist Convention president
item.description: South Carolina Pastor Josh Powell is slated to be nominated for president of the Southern Baptist Convention in June at the annual meeting for the nation's largest Protestant denomination. #JoshPowell #Baptists #SBC #president #SouthernBaptistConvention

item.title: 4 highlights from 'Melania' documentary about the first lady and her family
item.description: “Melania,” the new documentary about first lady Melania Trump, debuted in theaters on Friday and explores relationships with her family members and how she navigates the pressures of living in the spotlight. Here are four details “Melania” reveals about the first lady and her family. #MelaniaTrump #firstlady #PresidentTrump #WhiteHouse #Trumpadministration

item.title: IRF Summit issues call to confront rising religious persecution
item.description: The sixth annual International Religious Freedom Summit opened Monday with a call to intensify global advocacy for freedom of belief, as co-chairs warned that religious restrictions and persecution are rising worldwide even as the movement to defend conscience rights gains strength. #InternationalReligiousFreedomSummit #SamBrownback #KatrinaLantosSwett

item.title: Truett McConnell University names Larry Lyon as new president
item.description: Larry Lyon, the senior vice president for business administration at New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary, has been selected as the new president of Truett McConnell University. #TruettMcConnellUniversity #LarryLyon #president

item.title: Imprisoned Chinese pastor's daughter vows 'even repression cannot extinguish faith'
item.description: The daughter of an imprisoned Chinese pastor is expressing confidence as she shared the story of her father’s detention Monday during the sixth annual International Religious Freedom Summit, proclaiming that “even repression cannot extinguish us” and “God will not abandon us.” #InternationalReligiousFreedom #EzraJin #GraceJinDrexel #Religiousfreedom #XiJinping #China

item.title: Franklin Graham, Kathie Lee Gifford urge prayer as blood is found in home of Savannah Guthrie’s missing mother
item.description: Christian leaders, including Franklin Graham and Kathie Lee Gifford, have issued calls to prayer amid reports that blood was found in the home of “Today” co-host Savannah Guthrie’s missing 84-year-old mother, Nancy, raising fears she may have been the victim of foul play. #FranklinGraham #SavannahGuthrie #NancyGuthrie #KathieLeeGifford #crime

item.title: Apologist Wes Huff dismisses viral papyrus about Bible giants: 'Sensationalism'
item.description: Prominent Christian apologist Wes Huff recently dismissed an ancient Egyptian papyrus that has gone viral this week amid a report that it affirms the existence of the giants from the book of Genesis. #WesHuff #Nephilim #AnastasiI #Egypt

item.title: Ron Kenoly, influential worship leader who shaped modern praise music, dies at 81
item.description: Ron Kenoly, a pioneering Christian worship leader whose anthems helped shape modern praise music and whose ministry emphasized worship as service rather than performance, has died. He was 81. #RonKenoly #CCM #Christianmusic #worshipmusic

item.title: Border czar Tom Homan says over 145,000 missing children brought in under Biden have been found
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan recently announced that authorities have located more than 145,000 children that had been lost amid the millions of illegal immigrants that poured across the U.S. border under the Biden administration. #TomHoman #illegalimmigration #RobertFKennedyJr #Trump #missingchildren
